exact: coenzyme Q and cytochrome c reductase complex assembly
coenzyme Q and cytochrome c reductase complex biogenesis

definition: The aggregation, arrangement and bonding together of a set of components to form the cytochrome bc(1) complex, a transmembrane lipoprotein complex that it catalyzes the reduction of cytochrome c by accepting reducing equivalents from Coenzyme Q, by the aggregation, arrangement and bonding together of its constituents.
